item: R4 - the complete make verify-gpu, executed as one run with its real exit code
conclusion: make verify-gpu exits 0 end to end on 77dea49. Two earlier runs of the same command on this branch failed and are kept as the record of what had to be fixed.
tree_state: git status showed only the untracked _agent/ task directory before and after the run; the run regenerated Ent and schema.sql in place and left them byte-identical, and go.mod, go.sum and the embedded openapi.yaml match the digests recorded before the run (sha256sum -c all OK)

cache_disclosure.fact: 67 of the 74 ok lines in the gate log were Go test-cache results; 7 ran fresh, and the four -count=1 stages were fresh by construction
cache_disclosure.supplementary_run: the same package list was then re-executed with -count=1 through the same official broker script: /home/ubuntu/tx7do-pilot-run/T15/r4c-nocache.{log,exit}, exit 0, 69 ok lines, 0 cached, no FAIL or panic
cache_disclosure.why_it_matters: a cached ok is only as good as the run that produced it; this way the pass does not depend on cache reuse across the earlier failing tree

runs_that_failed_first_and_why.failure: make: *** [Makefile:240: verify-quota-ent] Error 1 - the gate's regeneration produced a migrate.go without the 32-line Diff/NamedDiff block that fc7804b had committed
runs_that_failed_first_and_why.cause: the R1 regeneration had used gow ent admin, which passes the sixth feature sql/versioned-migration (upstream gowind@v1.0.3/internal/ent/cmd.go:133), while the accepted artifacts match the gate's five-feature command
runs_that_failed_first_and_why.handling: commit 8fca316 keeps the tool-produced file that is byte-identical to accepted_head; scripts/verify-quota-schema.sh was not edited and tools/localdeps/gow was not edited

runs_that_failed_first_and_why.failure: verify-quota-ent and every regression stage passed, govulncheck reported 0 affected, then make: *** [Makefile:265: verify-gpu-audit] Error 1 with 'leaks found: 2'
runs_that_failed_first_and_why.cause: generic-api-key hits on the go dirhash of a public module revision inside T14's buildinfo evidence dumps, which the audit had never scanned because T14 recorded make verify-gpu as not_run
runs_that_failed_first_and_why.handling: commit 3054542 adds one reviewed exception pinned to the rule, both exact paths and the one exact value, with scripts/gitleaks-buildinfo-exception.sh as its negative controls; no rule disabled, no directory excluded, no baseline accepted, no exit code forced

explicitly_not_claimed: this gate is not runtime or deployment acceptance: the service was not started, no migration was applied and no business database was touched
the 12 upstream_known_defects cases stay classified failures; they are excluded from this gate by build tag and their own tagged runs exit non-zero
R5, R6 and R7 were not run this round
the 8 golang.org/x/image and 1 imported findings govulncheck lists are reachable-in-import only and are reported by the tool, not asserted benign here
